name: Taubaté

queries.query: Taubate Brazil official cadastral parcel map GIS natural resources real estate registration
queries.result: First-party Taubaté results identified SEPLAN na Mão, the municipal Planning and Housing Secretariat, the Municipal Finance page, and an official municipal cadastral-service document. The results establish local cadastral responsibilities and an official property-cadastre service, but did not expose a public anonymous parcel feature endpoint.

queries.query: Taubaté mapa cadastral lotes parcelas prefeitura SIG cadastro imobiliário
queries.result: First-party Portuguese results identify the Área de Cadastramento Técnico, which validates and monitors areas and lots and updates georeferenced data in the municipal SIG, plus the Divisão de Cadastro Técnico e Imobiliário and the public Ficha cadastral do Imóvel entry. No anonymous parcel geometry/API route was exposed by the indexed pages.

freshResearch.method: First-party web discovery followed by TLS-verified bounded GET inspection; no credentials, private tokens, login, CAPTCHA/Cloudflare bypass, unsafe-field request, or TLS disablement.

portalsFound.observation: Official municipal page assigns the Área de Cadastramento Técnico responsibility for cadastral validation/monitoring of municipal areas and lots and for updating georeferenced data in the SIG; local cadastral custody is evidenced, but no public parcel layer is published in the inspected result.
Official municipal Finance page identifies the Divisão de Cadastro Técnico e Imobiliário and its public-facing service context; it is local registry/cadastre evidence, not an anonymous geometry API.

Official SEPLAN page advertises maps and a Ficha cadastral do Imóvel. Direct bounded GET returned Cloudflare HTTP 403, so current JavaScript/configuration and service route could not be inspected without bypassing the access control.
Official service document describes the Área de Cadastro Técnico and cadastral/georeferenced municipal work; it does not provide a safe anonymous parcel geometry response.

requests.assessment: Cloudflare access wall; no bypass attempted. This is an inspection limitation, not evidence of cadastral absence.
Indexed official content was inspected; local cadastral custody was established, but no viewer configuration, service URL, schema, CRS, or parcel geometry response was exposed.
Indexed official content was inspected; the municipal cadastral division was identified, but no public parcel geometry endpoint was exposed.
